what: The data directory rule, as openbricks_sim.props.data_dir (Python) and markers::data_dir_from (the sim, Rust) both apply it: OPENBRICKS_DATA_DIR, else XDG_DATA_HOME/openbricks, else ~/.local/share/openbricks, with ~ = HOME, else USERPROFILE, else the working directory, and a leading ~ in either variable standing for it. Paths are written POSIX-style; each side compares with its separators normalised. A key that is missing is an unset variable; an empty string is a variable set to nothing, which does not count.
